blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Southeast Asian lawmakers must agree on a common message that will bring the concerns of their constituents to leaders of the Association of Southeast Asian Nations (Asean) and strengthen cooperation between the region’s governments and their parliaments. Philippine House Speaker Faustino “Bojie” G. Dy III stressed this on Saturday as he opened the 15th Asean–AIPA Leaders’ Interface parliamentary preparatory meeting at Makati Shangri-La. “As we gather here, our primary task is to bridge the voices of our people with the aspirational goals of Asean.
